examples.question:
Write a postmortem.
Title: Database connection pool exhaustion — 4 March 2026
Severity: P1
Duration: 32 minutes
Affected: All users unable to log in
What happened: A deploy introduced an unclosed database connection in the auth service. Under load connections were not returned to the pool and it exhausted.
Detection: PagerDuty alert on login error rate spike
Resolution: Rolled back the deploy
Root cause: Missing connection cleanup in error path of new auth middleware
examples.answer:
POST-INCIDENT REPORT
Incident: Database connection pool exhaustion — 4 March 2026
Severity: P1 | Duration: 32 minutes

1. SUMMARY
A deployment to the auth service introduced a connection leak that caused the database connection pool to exhaust under normal load, making login unavailable for all users for 32 minutes.

2. IMPACT
- All users unable to log in for 32 minutes
- Estimated sessions affected: [X]
- No data loss or corruption

3. TIMELINE
14:05 — Deploy to auth service completed
14:23 — PagerDuty alert fires: login error rate > 10%
14:26 — On-call engineer begins investigation
14:34 — Connection pool exhaustion identified in logs
14:37 — Decision to roll back deploy
14:43 — Rollback complete, error rate returns to baseline

4. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS
The new auth middleware did not close the database connection in its error handling path. Under normal traffic, connections leaked slowly. Within 18 minutes of deployment the pool was exhausted and all new auth requests failed immediately.

5. WHAT WENT WELL
- Alerting fired quickly (within 2 minutes of user impact)
- On-call response was fast
- Rollback procedure was well-practised and completed in 6 minutes

6. WHAT COULD BE IMPROVED
- The error path was not covered by integration tests
- No connection pool utilisation metric was being monitored
- Deploy review did not include a database resource checklist

7. ACTION ITEMS
1. [Owner TBD] — Add integration test for auth middleware error paths — Due: [TBD]
2. [Owner TBD] — Add connection pool utilisation to dashboards and alerts — Due: [TBD]
3. [Owner TBD] — Add DB connection hygiene to deploy review checklist — Due: [TBD]
